title: Trajectory Dynamics in Self-Supervised Learning Latent Space for Audio Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.13817v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human speech production is constrained by physiology, giving rise to characteristic temporal structure on acoustic signals. We hypothesise that these constraints manifest as structured trajectory dynamics in the latent space of Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) models, and that synthetic speech violates them detectably. To test this hypothesis, we train a causal Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) next-frame predictor on bonafide speech only (Stage 1), using the deepfake-specialised SSL backbone Wav2Vec2-Large-AntiDeepfake, and compare against a static global-average-pooling baseline using identical features, thus isolating the contribution of temporal modelling. A supervised Stage 2, which trains a Multi-Layer Perceptron on the frozen LSTM internal states using labelled data, is included to characterise the role of spoof supervision. Our system achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across six benchmarks: ASVspoof 2019/2021, Code

translated_title: 自监督学习潜在空间中轨迹动力学用于音频深度伪造检测
translated_abstract: 人类语音产生受生理学约束，导致声学信号上出现特征性的时间结构。我们假设这些约束在自监督学习（SSL）模型的潜在空间中表现为结构化的轨迹动力学，而合成语音可检测地违反这些约束。为验证此假设，我们仅使用真实语音训练一个因果长短期记忆（LSTM）下一帧预测器（阶段一），采用专门用于深度伪造的SSL骨干网络Wav2Vec2-Large-AntiDeepfake，并与使用相同特征的静态全局平均池化基线进行比较，从而隔离时间建模的贡献。阶段二为监督学习，使用带标签数据在冻结的LSTM内部状态上训练多层感知器，以表征欺骗监督的作用。我们的系统在六个基准测试中达到竞争性或最先进性能：ASVspoof 2019/2021、Code...
tldr: 本文提出利用自监督学习潜在空间中的轨迹动力学来检测音频深度伪造，通过仅训练真实语音的LSTM预测器并结合监督阶段，在多个基准上取得优异性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes detecting audio deepfakes by exploiting trajectory dynamics in self-supervised learning latent space, using an LSTM predictor trained only on bonafide speech with a supervised stage, achieving competitive or state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks.
